description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Imports and Exports Control Act, No. 1 of 1969
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates new regulations under the Imports and Exports Control Act, specifically the "Imports Control Regulations on Payment Terms No. 04 of 2024." It involves legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing regulations, operational instructions for authorities, and decision-making powers. While it mentions Ranil Wickremesinghe as Minister, this is only in the context of his authority to issue regulations under the Act, not detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes. The core content is regulatory framework and compliance requirements, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
